Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.service

Class PendingChange

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.petstore.service.PendingChange
public class PendingChange extends Object
One staged inline edit of a pet field, waiting on the Pending changes page to be applied or discarded.
Example:

PendingChange c = store.pendingChanges().stage(1, "name", "Sir Frisky", "alice"); // c.getState() == State.PENDING; the pet is unchanged until apply() store.pendingChanges().apply(c.getId(), "console:alice");
